_comment: One entry per published Howlin' Minute audio segment. audio_path is a public URL path served from public/audio/howlin-minute/. subject_teams (roster_ids) feeds the equal-airtime tracker; come_up_player feeds the recurring bit's no-repeat check. Newest last.

entries.title: The Ghost of Topeka
entries.script_text: You sitting there in Topeka, Rickyshanks, you think a little August shuffling makes you a general? I gave you the crown in twenty-three and you've been living off my ghost ever since. You want to trade away the heavy iron for rookie flyers? Go ahead. See how far a shiny new toy gets you when the winter wind blows through this league. I built dynasties with my bare hands while you were still figuring out how to set a lineup, and I am sick to death of men who forget who put them on the map. You want to win? It takes blood and it takes want-to, not a calculator and not a prayer. Look out for George Pickens, folks—that boy’s been sleeping upside down like a bat and he’s ready to hang from the rafters.

entries.title: The Clearance Aisle
entries.script_text: Riley Parker, you’re sitting over there in Vic Blends trying to buy a whole damn grocery store of parts, and you think putting together a lineup is like mixing a cocktail. I saw those moves. Dak Prescott, Puka Nacua, Chris Olave—you're collecting names like baseball cards while real men build dynasties out of dirt and blood. You traded for half the league's discarded spare parts and you expect the football gods to smile on a thrift store roster? Ain't nobody scared of a team built in the clearance aisle, Riley. You want to win this league, you got to want it more than you want a shiny new toy every four seconds. I told you in August and I'm telling you now, panic ain't a strategy. Look out for Rashee Rice, folks—he’s been running his routes backward in the dark just to feel something real.

entries.title: The Winterfell Shuffle
entries.script_text: You sitting there in Winterfell, Bryce Clenney, you think you pulled off a heist collecting Luther Burden and Terry McLaurin and DeVonta Smith and Travis Hunter like you are hoarding supplies for a long damn freeze. I told you in August and I am telling you right now. Stockpiling shiny names on a roster does not put a trophy on your mantel. You are trading for pieces while the men who actually want it are building empires. You think a handful of receivers is going to save your soul when you have never tasted the top of this league? You want to win, you have to bleed for it, not just shuffle assets like a coward at a card table. Look out for Drake Maye, folks—he has been eating his cornbread.

entries.title: The Ghost in the Corner
entries.script_text: You sitting there in the African Anteaters, Ross Minick, hiding out while the rest of this league burns rubber and trades picks like they're going out of style. You think silence is a strategy? You think sitting on your hands while your cousins and the rest of these fools blow up their rosters makes you some kind of sage? It doesn't. It makes you a ghost. Dynasty ain't a waiting room, Ross. It’s a butcher shop. You want to win this league? You got to bleed for it, not hide behind an animal name and hope nobody notices you're standing in the corner. I told you in August, I'll tell you again in December: rosters don't win, men win, and right now I don't see a man in your front office, just a shadow. Look out for Xavier Worthy, folks, he's been running his wind sprints backward to confuse the wind.
